name: Ishikawa Goemon
source:
Died at the age of 28.

In his past life, he was the greatest thief under the heavens, and made a name for himself for being chivalrous. While he is treated as a heinous criminal assigned to the bottom layer of Hell, the Eternal Hell, it seems he had his reasons for the crimes he committed.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/goemon/]Aksys Games[/url]]
